messages:
sophia_marketing: Hey team — quick request for launch next week. Need a compact benchmark carousel (3 slides) + a one‑pager for webinar registrants. Focus: latency vs cost tradeoffs, clear callouts for Dedicated vs Hosted placements. Deadline EOD Tuesday so we can run legal/ops review on Wed.

jordan_design: Got it. Do you have a preferred size for the carousel slides? mobile-first or desktop hero?

sophia_marketing: Mobile-first for social (1080x1080) plus a 16:9 widescreen export for the webinar deck. One‑pager should be A4 / US Letter with editable layers.

elaine_content: Copy notes: keep it benefit-led, not technical. Suggested headlines: "Serve smarter, ship faster" and "Save tokens without sacrificing latency." Short bullets: 1) Predictable latency, 2) Cost controls, 3) Simple rollouts. CTA: "See benchmarks + sign up for the webinar".

jordan_design: Can we get brand-safe hero illustrations instead of product screenshots? Less real UI = easier localization. Also need hex for accent: is #0067FF final?

sophia_marketing: Yes #0067FF is the accent. Use Inter for headings, Source Sans 400 for body. No photography for these assets — illustrations only.

mike_growth: For the one‑pager and slide exports, add tracking params to the CTA link: ?utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=inference_bench_may&utm_medium=asset. Also will need a separate PDF without utm for direct share (legal).

ria_prodops: Heads up — for the "Dedicated vs Hosted" callout, include a small compliance note: "Dedicated: contractual SLAs, export controls available". Keeping the copy short is fine but compliance wants that line in the footer for enterprise outbound.

jordan_design: Cool. I'll mock up the carousel (3 art variants: bold stat, split latency/cost chart, rollout checklist). PNGs 1080x1080 and 1920x1080. Will include layered Figma file and an export guideline:
```
Exports:
- PNG 1080x1080 (sRGB) - for socials
- PNG 1920x1080 (72dpi) - webinar hero
- PDF A4 with print bleed - one-pager
- Figma file: /Marketing/Launch/BenchCarousel
```

elaine_content: Quick micro-copy for the stat slide "Up to 3x cost savings with prefix caching + quantization". For the chart slide add caption: "Measured on 8k context, averaged across curated workloads."

mike_growth: Also request a short 1:1 video clip (15s) showing the three slides auto-advance for LinkedIn video ad. Can we get a 1080x1080 MP4 export?

jordan_design: Yep. I'll export a 1080 MP4 15s @30fps, H.264 baseline.

assetbot: Reminder: upload final Figma file to /assets/marketing/bench-launch/ by 2026-05-12 18:00 UTC for legal sign-off.

sophia_marketing: Thanks — please ping me when the first mock is ready. I'll consolidate feedback and route to legal + ops. :pray:
